requiredFindings.title: Give the rebuild-01 comparison a separate evidence procedure
requiredFindings.finding: After step 4 selects rebuild-02's observed receipt and executable, the same public drift check with rebuild-01 rejects before generation if the executable digest differs, as expected. A synthetic F8b assent does not bypass the tool pin or receipt/source joins. The proposed functional equivalence gate is therefore not specified in an executable form.

evidence.detail: Joins toolchain, closure and receipt before the pipeline call.
Rejects a supplied executable whose bytes differ from the selected tool pin before any generation.
Receipt sources must match the exact licensed Cargo.toml and receipt executable must match the selected generator.
Functional comparison must cover ordinary generation and --format-rust.

requiredFindings.requiredChange: Retain rebuild-02 for selected public drift. Specify separate disclosed comparison evidence using both observed binaries and identical prepared inputs, covering ordinary generation and --format-rust, with exact input/output/binary pins and scripts. Alternatively specify a coherent comparison snapshot and its distinct selection assumptions. Do not hand-edit receipts, weaken admission checks or label the separate old-binary probe as admitted F8b drift.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Limit the executable comparison claim to the available builds
nonBlockingObservations.observation: Rebuild-01 versus rebuild-02 normalized equality cannot verify native re-pin's historical rebuild403-versus-rebuild-01 explanation because the older bytes are gone.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: State only what the new two-build comparison establishes under its disclosed normalization, and preserve the historical limitation.

requestedJudgments.scope: Complete and minimal for the proposal; all tracked rows audited. Provisioned rows and generated-body equality remain later evidence gates.
requestedJudgments.successorVehicle: One contract successor is appropriate for both selected registries and related receipt/provenance updates, conditional on unchanged generated semantics.
requestedJudgments.observedRebuild: Sound and required to preserve the exact manifest-source join in the observed build receipt.
requestedJudgments.unchangedLockfiles: Sound for the metadata amendment, subject to the promised contracts npm ci evidence and explicit boundary-installation limitation.
requestedJudgments.processRule: Sound when the matching successor or EXIT-PLAN debt is recorded in the same commit; debt is disclosure, not admission.
